resources.string: When my view would be seen
Confirm before reacting or replying to a story

Applies to this account. Opening a story while ghost mode doesn\'t hide story views shows you in the viewers list; you can open it without being seen for that one session instead. Reacting to or replying to a story always marks it as seen on Telegram\'s servers, even in ghost mode. Preloading stories never marks them as seen.
Ghost mode isn\'t hiding story views for this account, so the author will see you in the viewers list.
Ghost mode hides your view. Reacting or replying will still mark the story as seen.
This will mark the story as seen
Telegram marks a story as seen when you react to it or reply to it, even with ghost mode on. The author will see you in the viewers list.
